title: the suites and the plugin run on Windows as they do on POSIX
description: Nineteen files fail on windows-latest for twelve causes, three of them product bugs a Windows user hits. Fix each cause red first (most reproduce on POSIX under an emulation of the Windows rule), and run every plan command under one POSIX shell on every platform.
desiredOutcome: CI's windows-latest selftests job is green, and the plugin's own commands (the raw log of an own run, a derived gate's observations, a printed remedy) work on Windows

findings.issue: The beside-git fallback tries usr\bin\sh.exe before bin\sh.exe; on a default Git for Windows install with only Git\cmd on PATH, the usr\bin shell started from a native process does not get usr\bin and mingw64\bin on PATH, so a plan command's grep/sed/xargs are missing and find/sort resolve to System32's find.exe and sort.exe, which run a different language and still return an exit code.
findings.resolution: fixed in P94.5-579 (5121f15a): Prefer bin\sh.exe (Git's wrapper, which sets PATH and MSYSTEM); when only usr\bin\sh.exe exists, hand the spawn the PATH entries it needs (usr\bin, mingw64\bin) through the same helper both spawn sites use; pin the order and the PATH in a case.

findings.issue: The docstring still says every step runs under shell=True, which this diff removed.
findings.resolution: fixed in P94.5-579 (5121f15a): Say sh -c through _proc_group.shell_argv; keep the rest of the sentence.

findings.file: PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (_proc_group tree line and section; gate-step paragraphs)
findings.issue: The architecture document does not describe resolve_sh/shell_argv or the refusal naming Git for Windows, and two paragraphs still say gate steps run under shell=True.
findings.resolution: fixed in P94.5-579 (5121f15a): Describe the resolution order, the absence of a cmd.exe fallback and the could-not-run refusal in the tree line and the section; say sh -c where it says shell=True.

findings.issue: Both say the --own raw log is gate-raw/<runId>.log, while its name is now the run id with non-portable characters mapped to '-'; no [Unreleased] entry covers the Windows spawn, the refusal or the log name.
findings.resolution: fixed in P94.5-579 (5121f15a): Describe the name as derived from the run id (colons become '-') or point at the printed raw log line; add the [Unreleased] entries.

findings.issue: The Windows half of _platform_temp_dirs is never reached by sr191, because an environment candidate answers first, so a mutation emptying the nt branch stays green; the case also patches os.name for the whole process.
findings.resolution: fixed in P94.6-579 (577bab77): Pass the platform into _platform_temp_dirs; add a case where every environment candidate is inside the repository or unset and LOCALAPPDATA points outside, asserting LOCALAPPDATA\Temp is chosen.

findings.issue: The SystemRoot rejection relies on os.path.normcase folding case and separators, which only ntpath does; on a POSIX host no case pins it, so dropping normcase stays green.
findings.resolution: fixed in P94.5-579 (5121f15a): Take the path module as a parameter defaulting to os.path; add a case calling it with ntpath and mixed case and separators, asserting rejection.

review.outcome: [findings: 6 - 0 high, 1 med, 5 low; 6 with a recorded fix commit]
